pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-02.png with Read and looked at it before reading any document. I read in this order. Tier 1, a wide panel: a doctor in a white coat types on a laptop at sunset. The top-left caption reads 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' Then the top-right teal label reads 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. The laptop screen shows a setup stepper. Tier 2 left: the doctor, now with a stethoscope, touches her chin and looks thoughtful. Balloon: 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Its tail reaches the side of her head. Tier 2 right: in a long shot, a receptionist in a blue kurta holds up a phone. The balloon at the top reads 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' A long tail runs down to her head. After that I read the teal label at the bottom, 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Tier 3: the seated doctor raises a fist and smiles. Balloon: 'One team. Better coordination.' Its tail points left to her mouth. The receptionist stands on the right holding a phone, smiling and silent.
pages.observation: I could read everything and the order felt natural. In panel 1, the caption on the left came first and the label on the right second. All tails reach the right speaker. In tier 2 right, the long tail ends at the receptionist's head, which is small in the frame, but there is no other candidate speaker. The 'WELBUK CARE' label covers the receptionist's lower body and part of the office chair. Her face and the hand holding the phone stay clear. In panel 1, the top-left caption sits right above the doctor's hair bun but does not cover her face. In tier 3, the balloon sits between the doctor and the receptionist. Its tail clearly goes to the doctor, so the shared-sounding line 'One team.' does not read as the receptionist's. Minor non-lettering point: the doctor has no stethoscope in panel 1 but wears one in panels 2 and 4. No blocking issues on this page.
